    20→    # - git checkout -B ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}

    27→    - echo [$(date +"%F %T")]
    28→    - |
    29→      # Retry logic with git pull/rebase to handle race conditions
    30→      for i in {1..3}; do
    31→        echo "Push attempt $i of 3..."
    32→      #  if git push origin ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}; then
    33→        if git push origin develop; then
    34→          echo "Push successful on attempt $i"

    38→            echo "Push failed after 3 attempts"

    40→          fi
    41→          echo "Push failed, pulling latest changes and retrying..."
    42→      #    git pull --rebase origin ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME} || true
    43→          git pull --rebase origin develop || true

     3→  script: |
     4→    echo [$(date +"%F %T")] Building Docker image...
     5→    echo "Using image tag: $IMAGE_TAG"
     6→
     7→    # Harbor 계정 확인
     8→    if [[ -z "${HARBOR_USER:-}" || -z "${HARBOR_PASSWORD:-}" ]]; then
     9→      echo "=========================================="
    10→      echo "ERROR: Missing required GitLab variables for Harbor access"

    14→
    15→    echo "Using Harbor URL: $HARBOR_URL"
    16→    echo "Using Harbor USER: $HARBOR_USER"

    18→

    20→    IMAGE_FULL_PATH=$HARBOR_URL/$HARBOR_PROJECT/$IMAGE_REPO_PATH:$IMAGE_TAG
    21→    echo "Image repository path: $IMAGE_FULL_PATH"
    22→

    24→    echo "$HARBOR_PASSWORD" | docker login "$HARBOR_URL" -u "$HARBOR_USER" --password-stdin

    29→      --build-arg PROJECT_PATH=$PROJECT_PATH \
    30→      -t "$IMAGE_FULL_PATH" \
    31→      -f "$PROJECT_PATH/Dockerfile" \
    32→      .
    33→    echo [$(date +"%F %T")] Pushing Docker image to Harbor...
    34→    docker push "$IMAGE_FULL_PATH" 
    35→    echo [$(date +"%F %T")] finished.
    36→  rules:
    37→    # Web UI 수동 트리거

    39→    # 기본적으로 비활성화 (각 프로젝트에서 규칙 오버라이드 필수)

1→# 이미지 태그 생성 전략
     2→# - main: 상대년도.월일-MR번호 (예: 1.0106.123)
     3→#   ㄴ 상대년도: 2026년=1, 2027년=2, ... (2025년 기준)
     4→# - 그 외: 커밋 해시 (예: 1.0106.123-dev / 1.0106.abc1234-dev)
     5→
     6→.set_image_tag:
     7→  before_script:
     8→    - |
     9→      # 상대년도.월일 형식 (2026년=1, 2027년=2, ...)
    10→      YEAR=$(date +%Y)
    11→      RELATIVE_YEAR=$((YEAR - 2025))
    12→      MMDD=$(date +%m%d)
    13→      DATE="${RELATIVE_YEAR}.${MMDD}"
    14→      
    15→      # Git commit message에서 MR 번호 추출 (GitLab merge commit 형식)
    16→      # 형식: "See merge request project/path!123"
    17→      echo "Debug: Git log message:"
    18→      git log -1 --pretty=%B
    19→      echo "---"
    20→      # grep -oE로 !숫자 패턴 찾고 sed로 ! 제거
    21→      MR_NUMBER=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep -oE '![0-9]+' | sed 's/!//' || echo "")
    22→      echo "Extracted MR_NUMBER: '${MR_NUMBER}'"
    23→      
    24→      if [ -n "$MR_NUMBER" ]; then
    25→        export IMAGE_TAG="${DATE}.${MR_NUMBER}"
    26→        echo "✅ image tag: ${IMAGE_TAG}"
    27→      else
    28→        # MR 번호를 찾지 못한 경우 fallback
    29→        export IMAGE_TAG="${DATE}.${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"
    30→        echo "⚠️  MR number not found, using: ${IMAGE_TAG}"
    31→      fi
    32→      
    33→      # main 브랜치 아닌경우 postfix -dev 추가
    34→      if [ "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" != "main" ] ; then
    35→        export IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG}-dev"
    36→        echo "📦 Development image tag: ${IMAGE_TAG}-dev"
    37→      fi
    38→

    26→
    27→  # 2. Java/Gradle 시스템 속성 전달을 위한 변수
    28→  # 호스트 변수는 순수한 IP 주소만 사용합니다.
    29→  HTTP_PROXY_HOST: "10.95.1.100"
    30→  HTTPS_PROXY_HOST: "10.95.1.100"

    33→  # 필요하다면 프록시를 사용하지 않을 내부 주소 설정 (예: K8s 서비스, GitLab 서버 등)
